content: Kotio, tenavu Saionini oru vaiha tentanavu kauqu aiqiqaa aquke tiva tauna uvarara iriha, ai autu tuahera karerave.
Are tenavu ai aare vauna uvara iri varianarara ti, ekaa vaiinti nahenti are iananaini oru vivarave.
Tenavu ai uva raqa kaunara kaara tinavu muntukavano qoraiqimanta vauraravata, are tinavu uva nunka timitaanara.

Are nena kaama taana vaiinti nahentika quaheha vaivara. Vika ai Naavu takuqi vairaqi quaheha variqi vivara. Tenavu ai Naavu takuqi vairaqi oru variariraro are tinavu koqema timitera haikava tinavu muntuka paruma timitaanaro.

Kotio, are ti ruaruama timite variaravama variaro. Tenavu ai aare vauna uvara irihara, are tinavu nora kaiqa, vo kaiqa vo kaiqa vara timitaanara taveha voqamake kauqu runkinkiri i vaunara. Ekaa maa vataraqaa variakave, nora namari hini mantaraini variakave, vika ariara noraiqaake iriqi vivera, vika koqemake vaivara.
Ai kempukavano uri aatarakero vairara tira, are nena kempukaqohaira ekaa aiqina nai vatuka nai vatukaqaa variate tira arataanara.

Nora namarivano noraiqaakero auva nte vaivara are vira qioqama kaararo kia qaiqaavata auva ntaira. Vo vatanaa vo vatanaaka naveraitiha iqoka raqi variavara are vika qioqama kaaramanta vika evaara variara.

Niaraini variakavata are nora kaiqa, vo kaiqa vo kaiqa vare varianara taveha, voqamake qeteha variara. Kuari urinaini variakave, kuari ruhunkinaini variakave, vika vika are nora kaiqa vare varianara taveha, ihi tivaqi viha ai quahama amite variara.

Are maa vataraqaa koqema kera raqikihara aaqu varake variararo vatavano koqe iro vaivaro karavanovata koqema kero qampiqe vaira. Are namari tuvinaini mpiqake vataararo namarivano koqemakero tuvi vaira. Are vata koqemakera vataararo viraqihairo vo kara vo karavano koqema kero qampiqe vaira.
Are aaqu koqemake varake variararo aaquvano vata korataara putama kaivaro vatavano uqera vivaro karavano qampiqe vaira.
Are mintima kehara vata vira koqemake variaramanta vaiinti nahenti vata viraqaahai airi kara qantuke vare variara. Are vi ani variana vataraqaahairo koqe karavano qampiqe vaira.
Qumina vataini koqe ukau qampiqe vaimanta purumakauve sipisipive mini mpiqavi variara. Aiqinaini koqe naaho vo naaho vo naahovano vaimanta vaiinti nahenti quaheha variara.
Ukau vainaini airi sipisipive, memeraave vi aniha ukau ne variamanta uqitaini uiti ututaavaro koqema kero qampiqeharo vi vatara mpiqe vaimanta vaiinti nahenti quaheha ihi tivaqi vi variara.
